title: 5 AI Engineering Roles Growing in 2026 — and What You Actually Need to Learn
description: Understand five AI engineering roles, the skills behind them, and where tools like Python, RAG and MCP fit. A free live online session with Suyog Joshi.
audience: College students, aspiring engineers, software professionals, tech leads, architects, and engineering managers
